about: Judgments the effect map can't take from Valeton's files: near matches (suggested by Claude by the developer's rules, for the developer to review), each with its reason. Used by tools/make-effect-map.js. Between two different effects, controls pair by name only; "controls" pairs a control with a differently named one, and null drops it. "standIn": an effect with nothing like it on the other pedal is replaced by this one, switched off, at its defaults (no settings carried); "inModule" gives the stand-in for another module the effect can sit in.

0x03000022.why: Developer, 2026-11-23: usable and close either way. Valeton describes this code three ways (Suite: Sora Fuzz, a Tone Bender Mk II; GP-50 manual: a Fuzz Face, likely copied from Red Haze; GP-200: Lazaro, a Big Muff); the same code is kept
